```yaml
name: FPCUnit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master, main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Free Pascal Compiler
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fpc fpc-source

      - name: Compile Tests
        run: |
          cd tests
          fpc RunTests.lpr

      - name: Run Tests
        run: |
          cd tests
          ./RunTests
```
